Download the ZIP for your Mac: `arm64` for Apple silicon, `x64` for Intel. Unzip and drag **GrokbotWidget.app** to Applications, then open **Grokbot Widget** from Finder or Raycast.

On first launch, choose your existing bot's exact name and optionally a custom image. The app installs the pinned BDK runtime and opens browser sign-in if needed. Node is included; no Terminal commands, Xcode, or separately installed Node are needed. Internet access is required for first setup and chat.

Right-click the widget for Settings, Sign in, logs, and Quit. Settings and private runtime state stay in your user Library. Cached bot avatars use a circular crop. Chat opens below the character near the top edge and preserves its collapsed position.

This build is ad-hoc signed, not Developer ID signed or notarized. If macOS blocks it, use System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway for this app. See the README for installation details and Apple’s guidance.

SHA-256 checksum files are included alongside each ZIP.
